# Regina: source provenance

Authors: Ben Burton and the Regina development team.

Source: https://github.com/regina-normal/regina/tree/e3a5c7c0e0581706d9e5531b750160b322489950

License: GNU GPL version 2 or later; preserve the complete upstream terms in LICENSE.txt.

Original three-dimensional example-triangulation constructions and a sample script querying a layered solid torus and normal surfaces. The script expects Regina's scripting environment and the engine files require the rest of Regina. These do not calculate a crochet material law or determine a hyperbolic reference metric.

Each copied file is unchanged. See ../sources.tsv for original Git blob identities. Execution and numerical acceptance: NOT_RUN.
